scope: Operator execution policies only; native hardware provenance remains in parameter_source_audit.json.
hash_convention: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON: ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)

vector_serial_policy_v1.title: 独立 Vector 串行执行与 UB 服务假设
vector_serial_policy_v1.verification: Explicit analytical policy; no published or measured UB bandwidth claim

normalization_serial_policy_v1.title: RMSNorm/Softmax 分行分阶段执行与归约依赖假设
normalization_serial_policy_v1.verification: Explicit coarse work and storage policy; no silicon calibration claim

materialized_block_policy_v1.title: Materialized Decode block schedule and storage-boundary work proxies
materialized_block_policy_v1.verification: Explicit symbolic storage and uncalibrated compute assumptions; no numerical or physical-layout validation claim

decode_attention_policy_v1.title: Single-token Decode with shared KV backing and serial query heads
decode_attention_policy_v1.verification: Native GEMM/Softmax reuse, independent workload/cache checks; symbolic layout and uncalibrated memory-service policies

ascend_ub_read_bpc.decision: Fixed uncalibrated 64*4 B/cycle UB service; only independent Ascend Vector uses it.

ascend_ub_write_bpc.decision: Fixed uncalibrated 64*4 B/cycle UB service; only independent Ascend Vector uses it.

configs/execution/vector.json.conditions: Separate execution profile; native hardware parameter counts/hashes unchanged. TSP/CIM share one policy.

fp32_sub_cost.decision: One scalar SUB modeled as one basic equivalent operation; shares native Vector/VXM budget, not calibrated.

fp32_max_cost.decision: One pairwise MAX comparison/selection modeled as one equivalent operation; not calibrated.

fp32_rcp_cost.decision: Algorithmic proxy: one seed-equivalent operation plus two Newton-style updates of two MUL and one SUB each: 1+2*3=7. Seed accuracy and numerical result are not modeled; not native reciprocal timing.

reduction_round_cycles.decision: Minimum compute dependency interval per tree level or cross-tile binary merge. Total compute is max(weighted-work cycles, this value); memory and startup charged separately. Not a measured shuffle or lane-network latency.

to_fp32_cost.decision: Coarse storage-boundary conversion work; no standalone instruction model.

to_int8_cost.decision: Coarse scale/round/clamp work proxy; no numerical quantization or standalone instruction model.

fp32_rcp_cost.decision: Reciprocal work proxy on the shared Vector/VXM budget.

configs/execution/attention.json.conditions: Single-token Decode with uniform cache lengths. INT8 what-if storage, FP32 scale/Softmax. Preallocated per-KV-head backing is shared; each query head rereads K/V using native GEMM, with no physical repeat or transpose instruction. Q/K/V projection, position processing, output projection, cache eviction and chip execution are outside this block.

decode_projection_blocks.conditions: Single-token bias-free GQA projections. INT8 activation/matrix weights and outputs; RMSNorm scale weight and internal normalization FP32. Existing to_fp32/to_int8 proxies, no new measured hardware rate. Serial materialized nodes; head/matrix views share storage symbolically and require physical layout validation. No RoPE, numeric quantization, MLA composition or chip execution.

decode_position_vocabulary_blocks.conditions: Single-token full-head adjacent-channel RoPE with one uniform batch position and supplied FP32 cos/sin tables. No table generation; tables reread per head. INT8 Q/K and embedding/output activations; vocabulary logits FP32. Embedding assumes symbolic valid INT32 indices, complete INT8 table residency and no duplicate-row cache. Native matrix and existing conversion/SUB costs reused; no new hardware rates, address-generation or gather/transpose instructions, numeric accuracy, MLA composition or chip execution.
decode_position_vocabulary_blocks.rope_workspace: One pair uses 8 B converted input plus four 4 B products; converted-input slots become rotation results only after all four products. Local stored input/table/output slots add 12 B per pair.
decode_position_vocabulary_blocks.embedding_workspace: Local DMA path retains a 4 B index and one reusable row tile. Resident MEM copies have no second full table/output copy; transient address registers are not modeled.
